tasks.label: Run Active File
args: if [ "${fileExtname}" = ".py" ]; then python3 "${file}"; elif [ "${fileExtname}" = ".cpp" ]; then if [[ "${fileBasename}" == *"test"* ]]; then echo "[INFO] Detected Test File. Running via CMake/CTest..."; cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure; else echo "[INFO] Compiling & Running Simulation..."; g++ -std=c++17 -fdiagnostics-color=always -g -I pid_controller "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}" && "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; fi; else echo "Unsupported file type"; fi
